text: {"findings":[{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Experiment duration under 14 days","detail":"A 5-day run is below the 14-day minimum and cannot capture weekly demand cycles. The plan also states no MDE or power calculation.","evidence_quote":"Run for 5 days.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Run for at least 14 days (ideally covering two full weekly cycles) and document MDE, sample size, and power."},{"type":"WEAK_EXPERIMENT_DESIGN","title":"Randomization by driver leaks between arms","detail":"Dispatch assigns offers by matching drivers to orders in a shared pool. Randomizing by driver means treatment and control drivers compete for the same orders, so the arms interfere with each other. A cleaner unit would be a geographic zone, a time window, or a zone-time switchback.","evidence_quote":"A/B test randomized by driver.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Randomize by zone or zone-time switchback so that orders and drivers in the same marketplace pool stay in a single arm."},{"type":"MISSING_GUARDRAIL","title":"Dispatch-related guardrails absent","detail":"Changing the dispatch algorithm can affect driver earnings distribution, offer acceptance or decline rates, and delivery time or cost. Guardrails for these are missing. The proposal also favors rating tie-breaks, which could concentrate work among some drivers.","evidence_quote":"Delivery Defect Rate: stop if it rises by more than 0.2 points.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Add guardrails such as offer acceptance rate, driver earnings and utilization distribution, average delivery time, and cost per delivery, with stop thresholds."},{"type":"POLICY_REVIEW","title":"Driver-affecting assignment change without review recorded","detail":"Changing dispatch priority, including rating-based tie-breaks, alters work and earnings allocation among drivers, a pay-adjacent policy area. The Reviews section lists only engineering capacity and no pay, fairness, or policy review.","evidence_quote":"Dispatch engineering has capacity next sprint.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Record review from the relevant driver pay/policy and legal or fairness owners before launch."},{"type":"NO_BASELINE_TARGET","title":"Target timeframe inconsistent with experiment","detail":"The success metric's 6-week target window does not match the 5-day experiment, so the target cannot be evaluated by the planned test.","evidence_quote":"On-Time Delivery Rate: baseline 87%, target 89% within 6 weeks.","citations":[],"recommendation":"Align the experiment duration and readout with the target timeframe, or define an interim target measurable within the test."}]}
